headline: US Warns Citizens as Houthi Attacks Target Saudi Airports
summary: The US issued a warning advising citizens in Saudi Arabia to exercise extreme caution after Houthi attacks disrupted civilian airports and infrastructure.
why: Security threats across Gulf infrastructure create risk premiums for regional transit corridors and international oil shipping.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: Escalating security risks to Gulf transportation hubs add geopolitical risk premiums to crude markets.
